responsibility: Implements GCC’s AutoFDO profile-use pass for sampled profiles. This file reads AFDO data through the gcov profile format support, builds source and inline-stack profile mappings, and then runs an IPA pass that first uses sampled indirect-call and callsite hotness information to drive value-profile-based call promotion and aggressive early inlining so the IR matches the profiled binary, and then annotates each function’s CFG with basic-block counts, edge probabilities, and function frequency/count data. It owns the AutoFDO-specific profile structures, profile loading/teardown entry points, callsite hotness query used by inlining, and the pass hook that integrates sampled profiles into the normal GCC profiling infrastructure.
same_name_distinction: This source file is the AutoFDO implementation behind gcc/auto-profile.h: it defines sampled-profile data structures, reads AFDO records via gcov I/O, runs the IPA AutoFDO pass, performs early inlining/value-profile-driven promotion, and annotates CFG counts and probabilities. The same-stem header only declares the small external entry points and hot-callsite query.
